scripts.bootstrap: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.copy:frontend: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const path=require('path'); const src=path.resolve('frontend/dist'); const dest=path.resolve('backend/public'); if(fs.existsSync(dest)) fs.rmSync(dest, {recursive:true, force:true}); if(fs.existsSync(src)) fs.cpSync(src, dest, {recursive:true}); console.log('✅ Compiled frontend copied to backend/public!');"
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run copy:frontend
